proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the target-relevant information operator after shared-control projection, a concrete rescue example, and the sharp three-regime oracle minimax frontier. It repaired uniform zero selection, fourth-moment tangent-path scope, and theorem-level positioning, and proved a feasible estimator matches the oracle rate in explicit nuisance-smoothness regions. The field target collapsed because outside those regions the result remains an estimator-specific upper bracket rather than a complete feasible minimax frontier; closing that gap requires a new joint first-stage/response lower bound or higher-order regularization theory.
tldr: The paper identifies which weak histories obstruct a weighted contemporaneous response after carryover removal and global shared-control projection, proves shared-control rescue, and establishes the sharp known-operator scalar frontier. It also resolves tangent saturation pointwise: at laws satisfying \(\mathrm{P1}\)--\(\mathrm{P4}\), including strict fourth-moment interiority, the closed maintained-path score space equals the closed differentiated-restriction space; every maintained path satisfies the conditional representation even without those sufficient primitive conditions. In the feasible fixed-weight chart, one class-wide separation constant makes the eligible zero uniformly selectable; a Neyman-orthogonal outside score and local-IV polynomial reconstruction attain the oracle rate exactly in the regions stated by thm:nuisance-envelope-thresholds. Outside those regions, \(\rho_n+B_{\mathrm{nuis}}\) is only a proved upper bound, and a matching product-term lower bound remains open.
gap: Repeated-treatment IV theory uses full rank at every history. Breunig--Johannes already give same-sample unknown-operator linear-functional minimax and adaptive theory, including the same base-case exponent pattern, but their compact global-link class excludes a localized multiplication zero and their fixed representer does not absorb an unknown first stage. Existing work does not supply the source model's global shared-control correction or a sharp learned local-zero frontier.
fill: An exact global-projection information criterion on a valid L2 domain, a shared-control rescue, a sharp oracle benchmark, and a concentration-backed feasible upper envelope whose explicit nuisance terms define the remaining sharpness problem.
